Fall 2010 BOT/CAL Release of Funds
Questions?
Ask Finaid!
Attention: Texas B-On-Time (BOT) loan and Texas College Access Loan (CAL) Borrowers
We are still waiting for the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board (THECB) to send many of these loan funds. Once these funds arrive in our office and we are able to release them, we will notify you via e-mail.
For the most up to date status of your loan, please contact the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board, the state agency making these loans. Their contact number is 1(800)242-3062.
